text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Instead of just reading words as symbols, NLP enables machines to grasp the meaning behind sentences, including context and tone. This technology powers many everyday tools. For example, online translation services can instantly convert text between languages, making global communication much easier. Sentiment analysis is another useful application, allowing companies to scan customer reviews to see if people feel positive or negative about a product. Chatbots, which are common on websites, also rely on NLP to answer questions and hold helpful conversations, giving users quick and friendly support.
